text: Behavioral Warning (The Isolation Trap): This protocol demands starving your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine (excitement, novelty, the chase), and the easiest way to do that is to hole up alone, but do not isolate completely. Total social isolation spikes cortisol, the chronic stress hormone, which makes your brain more sensitive to glutamate, and that locks the armor in place whether or not you've ever had an addiction. We're social animals, so what you need is the calm kind of company, the kind that gives you oxytocin instead of a dopamine spike (the "Oxytocinergic Anchoring" the rule below is about).
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings at the top: the Behavioral Warning
reader: an adult with trauma or an addiction who has read the short introduction and is reading the warnings before starting the protocol, who tends to withdraw from people when working on themselves
